record.paper_title: 25 Open Questions About Vector Bundles and Their Moduli
record.original_question: After identifying suitable local invariants for W_k, construct a Hausdorff stratification of the moduli stack M_n(W_k) of holomorphic vector bundles E on W_k with local holomorphic Euler characteristic χ(ℓ,E)=n.

evidence.quote: Question 21. Construct a Hausdorff stratification of the moduli stack Mn(Wk) of holomorphic bundles on Wk with χ(ℓ, E) = n.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k\geq 1$ be an integer and let $W_k$ denote the total space of the line bundle $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(-k)$ over $\mathbb{P}^1$, viewed as a smooth complex surface containing the zero-section $\ell\cong\mathbb{P}^1$ with self-intersection $\ell^2=-k$. For a holomorphic vector bundle $E$ on $W_k$, define the local holomorphic Euler characteristic of $E$ along $\ell$ by
$$\chi(\ell,E)\;=\;h^0(W_k,(R^0\pi_*\widehat E)/E_\infty)\;+\;h^0(W_k,R^1\pi_*\widehat E),$$
where $\pi:W_k\to X_k$ is the contraction of $\ell$ to the singular point of the affine surface $X_k$ and $\widehat{E}$ is the formal completion of $E$ along $\ell$ (equivalently, $\chi(\ell,E)=h^0(\ell,E_\infty/E)+h^1(W_k,E)$ for an appropriate extension $E_\infty$). Fix a positive integer $n$, and let $\mathcal{M}_n(W_k)$ denote the moduli stack of holomorphic rank-$r$ vector bundles $E$ on $W_k$ with $\chi(\ell,E)=n$.

Identify a complete set of local holomorphic invariants for bundles on $W_k$ and use them to construct a Hausdorff stratification of $\mathcal{M}_n(W_k)$, that is, a decomposition of $\mathcal{M}_n(W_k)$ into locally closed substrata, each of which is a Hausdorff space (or coarse moduli space), such that the closure of each stratum is a union of strata.
artifact.category_tag: moduli of vector bundles on surfaces
artifact.status_search_result: Foundational work by Ballico–Gasparim–Köppe and related authors constructs moduli of bundles on the local surfaces $W_k$ (also denoted $Z_k$) as stratified spaces and provides bounds on the local holomorphic Euler characteristic, but a complete Hausdorff stratification of $\mathcal{M}_n(W_k)$ for general $n$ and $k$ does not appear to be established in the literature accessible via search; the question appears to remain open or only partially addressed.

status_evidence.title: Vector bundles near negative curves: moduli and local Euler characteristic
status_evidence.snippet: Explicit construction of moduli of bundles on Z_k as stratified spaces and sharp bounds for the local holomorphic Euler characteristic.
status_evidence.claim: Partial stratification results exist but a full Hausdorff stratification is not asserted.

status_evidence.title: Moduli Stacks of Bundles on Local Surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of moduli stacks of bundles on W_k and the role of local invariants.
status_evidence.claim: The construction of a Hausdorff stratification of M_n(W_k) is posed as an open problem.
